prompts:
Create zealot-d.png, a production animation sprite sheet for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. Output exactly 1536x1024 landscape with genuinely transparent background (real alpha), no background color, floor, ground shadows, text, labels, numbers, borders, effects, dust or motion lines.
Reference image attached in conversation is master-side.png: locked character design and style reference. Match exactly its stern clean-shaven square-jawed adult man's face, burnished conical steel helmet with short nasal guard, white wool cloak with muddy brown hem, white tabard with large gold sunburst on left breast, steel breastplate and greaves, grey chainmail sleeves, brown gloves belt boots, round white wooden shield with gold sunburst and steel rim on LEFT forearm, straight steel arming sword with brass crossguard in RIGHT hand. Keep sword and shield identical in size and shape across all frames, with natural perspective foreshortening only. Preserve proportions, details, colors and rendering from reference.
Hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art in spirit of Streets of Rage 4: confident near-black/dark brown outlines thicker on silhouette, thinner internally, clean 2-3 step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients, upper-left soft lighting, gentle cool right rim. Not pixel art, 3D, photoreal or chibi. Kid-friendly no blood or gore.
Layout EXACTLY eight separate full-body figures, TWO rows of FOUR frames, reading left to right then next row. Invisible cells 384x512. Shared baseline y=490 for top row and y=1000 for lower row. Maintain one uniform character anatomical scale throughout, as large as fits all poses with clear transparent gaps and margin. Standing height approximately 340 pixels, leaving space for raised sword. Do not make sitting figure anatomically smaller. All limbs, boots, shield and sword stay within each cell, no overlap between figures. Exactly two arms, two legs, two booted feet and anatomically correct five-finger hands per figure. Eight genuinely distinct sequential drawings, not repeated or mirrored poses.
TOP ROW all face LEFT:
1 GET UP: on one knee, left shield arm bracing its gloved hand on ground, right hand grasping sword beside him, starting to push upward; cloak gathered behind.
2 GET UP continuation: rising from knee, almost standing, hips lifted, front boot planted, rear knee leaving ground, shield returning toward defensive position, sword gripped low.
3 COMEDY MUD SLIP: boots sliding out from under him, body tilted backward, startled face, both arms flailing outward with shield and sword held wide; retain both weapons and all anatomy, no drawn mud ground or effects.
4 SITTING IN MUD COMEDY: seated directly on shared baseline, both legs extended toward left, offended horrified expression, lifting the dirty cloak hem with gloved hand to inspect it; shield remains on left forearm, sword retained in right hand while gathering cloth. No mud puddle or floor, only mud stains on garment.
BOTTOM ROW four successive FLEE running cycle poses: body and boots face RIGHT, fleeing RIGHT, head looks back over shoulder to LEFT with scared face. LEFT shield arm trails behind toward left (shield on back arm), RIGHT hand holds sword UP; same gear, scale and facial identity. Cloak streams behind toward left.
5 left boot forward reaching right, right leg behind pushing off.
6 first passing pose: right knee swings forward under hips, left leg supporting, slight downward body bob.
7 right boot forward reaching right, left leg behind pushing off, distinct from frame 5 anatomically.
8 second passing pose: left knee swings forward, right leg supporting, slight upward body bob, different from frame 6.
Draw exactly these eight moments with readable silhouettes and reference-level detail. Transparency is essential.
